title: Form 990 Schedule D and annual DAF reporting data package
status_rationale: Specified in Unbound requirements (cited) but not implemented; no production deployment, operating evidence or independent review exists (architecture/ECHELON-CURRENT-STATE-BRIEF.md).
target_answer: For each legal sponsor and tax year, Unbound produces a reproducible DAF annual reporting data package from the locked ledger: count of donor-advised funds at year end, aggregate contributions, grants and year-end value (each defined in a CPA-approved, form-year-versioned data dictionary mapped to current form lines), the transfer-out subset, and evidence for the donor written-disclosure questions. Which account types count as DAFs comes from a counsel-approved classification register. A DAF bridge reconciles Schedule D Part I line 4 to the sum of year-end fund statements and the DAF component of audited net assets, and lines 2 and 3 to the statement of activities, using only typed reconciling items; any unexplained residual blocks sign-off. Grants carry Schedule I and F attributes at approval and recipient aggregates reconcile to total grants with zero unexplained difference. Estimated UBIT accrues with Form 990-T installment support. Preparation, review, signature, filing and acceptance are distinct states; amended packages repeat them; AI has no signing or filing authority.

title: Contribution acknowledgments and IRS substantiation
status_rationale: Specified in Unbound requirements (cited) but not implemented; no production deployment, operating evidence or independent review exists (architecture/ECHELON-CURRENT-STATE-BRIEF.md).
target_answer: Acknowledgments are issued only through a gated command that validates a counsel-approved, versioned sponsor template containing every mandatory element: the statement that the sponsoring organization has exclusive legal control over the contributed assets, the goods-or-services statement, cash amount or noncash description (without a sponsor valuation of noncash property), donor and sponsor identity, and contribution date; issuance is blocked if any element is missing. Each contribution records gift completion, acceptance, availability and acknowledgment dates separately. Acknowledgment timing for reversible rails is sponsor-configured (default after finality); a returned ACH or chargeback voids or amends the acknowledgment through a recorded correction. The contributor of record is determined by a CPA- and counsel-approved rule and never defaults to the advisory-privilege holder. Statements are never presented as acknowledgments, and tax disclosures never imply nonitemizer deductibility. Legally significant wording cannot be altered by sponsor branding. Issued documents are immutable and accessible.

title: Noncash gift reporting: Forms 8283 and 8282
status_rationale: Specified in Unbound requirements (cited) but not implemented; no production deployment, operating evidence or independent review exists (architecture/ECHELON-CURRENT-STATE-BRIEF.md).
target_answer: When the sponsor signs a donor's Form 8283 Section B, Unbound records the signature event, property description, lot identifiers and date of receipt, and records that the signature acknowledges receipt, not value. Any sale or other disposition of such a lot within the counsel-configured reporting window creates a Form 8282 obligation with due date, owner and donor-copy task, tracked to filing evidence with escalation. Multi-lot securities intents close as partial after the sponsor window and acknowledgments and Form 8283 cover only received lots. For complex-asset gifts through intermediaries, the counsel-approved structure (agent model by default) determines the donee of record for acknowledgment, Form 8283 and 8282 duties.

title: Information returns (Forms 1099) and payee tax identity
status_rationale: No Unbound requirement specifies Form 1099 determination, TIN collection or information-return data; sponsor operating accounts payable is explicitly out of initial scope (RR-UNB-ACC-012-r1). Applicability has not been analyzed.
target_answer: Recommended target (not yet a requirement): Unbound classifies every payee by tax status at onboarding and flags payments that may require information returns under a CPA-approved rule table, for example payments to non-exempt persons such as referral or service fees paid from sponsor operating funds. Grants to tax-exempt charities are not expected to require Form 1099 reporting, and DAFs do not make grants to individuals. Where a flag applies, Unbound collects and validates payee TIN data through the sponsor's process and exports summarized, reconciled data to the sponsor's accounts payable or 1099 system of record; it does not file. Processor-issued Forms 1099-K to the sponsor are reconciled to recorded contributions by processor and period.

title: OFAC blocked property and rejected transaction reporting
status_rationale: Specified in Unbound requirements (cited) but not implemented; no production deployment, operating evidence or independent review exists (architecture/ECHELON-CURRENT-STATE-BRIEF.md).
target_answer: Only an authorized human confirms a sanctions true match. On confirmation involving property in the sponsor's possession, the system records the property as blocked, prevents any movement (BlockedProperty ledger classification), stops retry, reissue and capacity restoration, opens a sanctions case, generates blocked-property report data due to OFAC within 10 business days, tracks the annual report of blocked property and retains related records for at least 10 years. A confirmed match without property in possession refuses the transaction and produces rejected-transaction report data within 10 business days. Intermediary or provider blocking notices also move a payment to Blocked. Reliance on OFAC general licenses is versioned and re-verified. Unbound prepares report data; the sponsor files.

title: Unclaimed property reporting for uncashed grants and dormant accounts
status_rationale: Specified in Unbound requirements (cited) but not implemented; no production deployment, operating evidence or independent review exists (architecture/ECHELON-CURRENT-STATE-BRIEF.md).
target_answer: Uncashed grant checks follow explicit states (Issued, Outstanding, AgedOutreach, StaleDated, VoidRequested, VoidConfirmed, Cleared, UnclaimedPropertyReportable). Outstanding uncashed grant checks are presumed reportable property owed to the payee charity. The reporting state is the payee's last known address state, else the sponsor's state of incorporation (fixed rule XID-BNK-003). A counsel-approved, statute-derived UnclaimedPropertyRule table per state gives dormancy period, exemptions, due-diligence notice window and content, and report and remittance dates. Two outreach attempts, including an offer to reissue by ACH, precede dormancy. Void and re-credit to the fund is permitted only if the grant was cancelled before cashing with notice to the charity and the state rule allows; an item with no rule row stays in review and is never re-credited. Unknown inputs default to hold and report at dormancy. Dormant DAF accounts follow a sponsor dormancy policy with charitable default disposition; escheat processing is limited to payment instruments unless counsel records otherwise.

title: Audit-ready reporting packages and regulatory reporting accuracy evidence
status_rationale: Specified in Unbound requirements (cited) but not implemented; no production deployment, operating evidence or independent review exists (architecture/ECHELON-CURRENT-STATE-BRIEF.md).
target_answer: Unbound generates auditor-ready, time-bounded, reproducible packages: audit schedules, roll-forwards, supporting workpapers, transaction drill-down and independently verifiable as-of snapshots, exported through Folio with chain of custody and access redaction. External auditors receive time-limited, least-privilege, read-only workspaces with activity history. Every regulatory or tax report reconciles to the locked ledger with typed reconciling items and zero unexplained difference, and carries information-produced-by-entity support (query definition, parameters, population counts, hash, run log). Reports are reproducible exactly as filed. Audit adjustments post only in a period 13 linked to audit findings. Preparation, review and sign-off are separate principals and AI cannot sign or file. Package integrity is verified before release. None of this replaces the sponsor's external audit or an independent SOC report, which do not yet exist for Unbound.

challenge.customer_intent: Year-end audit and regulatory reports are fast, complete and defensible.
challenge.adverse_outcome: Audit delays, qualified opinions, inaccurate filings.
challenge.conventional_control_effectiveness: Prepared-by-client lists fulfilled manually; accuracy depends on staff extracts that auditors must test separately.
challenge.legally_required: Audits are required for many charities by state law or funders; the package format is not.
challenge.contractually_required: Sponsors expect vendor support for audits.
challenge.historical_convention: Manual PBC fulfillment and spreadsheet roll-forwards.
challenge.architectural_elimination: Manual extraction error removed when packages are pure queries over a certified close snapshot.
challenge.automatic_enforcement: Integrity verification and zero-residual reconciliation gate package release.
challenge.continuous_evidence: IPE metadata and hashes generated with every report.
challenge.stronger_alternative: Generated, reproducible packages with auditor re-performance access.
challenge.alternative_verifiable: Yes, through read-only auditor workspace and re-runnable queries.
challenge.customer_acceptance_likelihood: Likely for efficiency; reliance level is the auditor's decision.
challenge.invalidating_conditions: Auditor tests IPE and finds query definitions or populations unreliable.
challenge.alternative_risks: Errors in shared query logic affect every package consistently.
supporting_arguments: Reproducibility allows auditors to test once and rely on logic.
opposing_arguments: Auditors must still test IPE each period; savings may be smaller than expected.
A new vendor without SOC reports gets limited reliance.
